paragraphs: BurnBot sells wildfire fuels management, equipping infrastructure operators, communities, agencies and ecological partners with tools and services. The work runs from fire mitigation and fuels management to timber operations.

The equipment is remote-controlled masticators and blackline machines. Crews pair the machines with real-time telemetry and monitoring. Because operators work remotely, treatments can be made in steep, remote or hazardous areas. The company says the machines run around the clock in most weather conditions. Prescribed burning uses controlled ignition systems on land and in the air. Projects are documented with dynamic treatment maps and fuel load models.

Government customers are described as federal, state, tribal and local land managers. On the community side, the site names WUI neighborhoods, fire safe councils and cooperatives. The company says it is a qualified contractor for both personnel and equipment, supporting state and federal agencies. It says it was built by fire practitioners, scientists and foresters. Its headquarters is in South San Francisco, California.

quote.text: BurnBot is a qualified contractor for both personnel and equipment, supporting state and federal agencies with safe, effective wildfire operations.
